name: Daniachat – دانیا
author: daniachat

sections.description:
Daniachat connects your website to the hosted Daniachat service. An active Daniachat account is required. Service plans and usage limits are managed by Daniachat; the plugin does not include a local AI model.

The WordPress dashboard interface is in Persian.

  • Show the hosted Daniachat assistant on your site.
  • Synchronize public posts, pages, and WooCommerce products with your workspace knowledge base.
  • Run content synchronization in small batches with progress feedback.
  • Remove previously synchronized sources when content is unpublished or deleted.
  • View conversations, reply to human support requests, and see activity reports in WordPress.
  • Retrieve live WooCommerce product details, prices, stock, and categories.
  • Look up an order using its order number and matching billing email.
  • Let shoppers manage their own WooCommerce cart and apply coupons through chat.
  • Configure the widget color, welcome message, and desktop/mobile position.

WooCommerce is optional. Content synchronization and customer support work without it. Password-protected content, drafts, private posts, and hidden catalog products are excluded from knowledge synchronization. Custom membership/access-control plugins require a separate compatibility review.

External services

This plugin uses the Daniachat software-as-a-service platform at https://daniachat.ir. It provides AI responses, knowledge indexing, conversation storage, support handoff, and reports. These features require an Internet connection and a Daniachat account.

No connection to Daniachat is initiated merely by activating an unconfigured plugin. The administrator must sign in and explicitly confirm the data-sharing notice before connecting the site. Connecting enables the widget, synchronization of public content, and WooCommerce features when WooCommerce is active. If the selected workspace has no knowledge sources, an initial content synchronization starts after connection. Administrators can disable these features in the plugin settings or disconnect their account.

Data sent to Daniachat and when:

  • During sign-in and session renewal: the Daniachat account email, password, and authentication/session information over HTTPS. Credentials are stored encrypted in the site’s WordPress database using its security salts. They are not exposed to front-end visitors.
  • During setup and configuration: the site name, URL, selected workspace, widget settings, installation key, and the signed WooCommerce gateway configuration.
  • During content synchronization: public content titles, text, excerpts, URLs, and identifiers; public product descriptions, SKU, categories, prices, and stock. The service stores and indexes this content in the selected workspace.
  • When visitors use the assistant: their chat messages, conversation/visitor identifiers, and contact information they choose to provide. The hosted widget also processes page URL/product context and technical connection information, such as IP address and browser request headers. Browser storage maintains the conversation session.
  • When shopping features are used: product searches and product details, or the order number and billing email supplied for order lookup and the matching order status/details. Cart actions run in that visitor’s WooCommerce browser session and return their result to the assistant. The plugin does not collect payment-card details.
  • When an administrator opens conversations or reports: requests for the selected workspace and any support replies entered by that administrator.

The public chat loader is served from https://daniachat.ir/embed/v2/embed.js and displays the service in an iframe from the same domain. These are part of the hosted chat service and can be updated by Daniachat independently of the plugin. Local dashboard JavaScript, CSS, and logo images are included in the plugin; it does not load unrelated third-party CDN libraries.

Service: https://daniachat.ir/
Terms of use: https://daniachat.ir/terms
Privacy policy: https://daniachat.ir/privacy

Site owners should disclose this processing in their own privacy policy and obtain any consent required for their use. Suggested text is available in the WordPress Privacy Policy Guide. Deactivation stops this plugin from loading the widget and scheduling synchronization; it does not erase remotely stored data or revoke the remote integration. Disconnect the account first to disable the commerce integration and clear local credentials. Deleting the plugin removes its local settings, secrets, synchronization metadata, and scheduled tasks. Previously synchronized content and conversations remain in the Daniachat workspace and must be managed there.
sections.installation:
1. In WordPress, open Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin and upload daniachat.zip. Alternatively, upload the daniachat folder to wp-content/plugins/.
  2. Activate Daniachat.
  3. Open Dania in the WordPress menu. Review the data-sharing notice and linked service policies.
  4. Sign in with your Daniachat account and confirm the notice. If your account has several workspaces, select the workspace for this site.
  5. Complete the initial synchronization if shown, then review widget, synchronization, and optional WooCommerce settings.
  6. Open your site as a visitor and test the assistant.

PHP must provide the OpenSSL extension with AES-256-GCM support to store credentials securely. WooCommerce is only needed for shopping features. Connect each site individually on WordPress multisite; network-wide provisioning is not provided.
sections.faq:
Is a Daniachat account required?

Yes. This plugin connects to a hosted service. Create an account at https://daniachat.ir/ and review its current plans and usage limits.

Is WooCommerce required?

No. It is only required for live product, order, and cart features.

Is private content synchronized?

Drafts, private posts, password-protected posts/pages/products, and hidden catalog products are excluded. Content protected by another membership plugin needs a separate compatibility review before enabling synchronization.

What happens when I remove the plugin?

Local plugin data is removed on uninstall. Your existing Daniachat workspace data is not deleted. Manage its retention and deletion from Daniachat.

Will existing installations keep their settings?

Yes. The main plugin filename, existing option keys, and REST namespace are retained for compatibility. The package folder and translation domain are daniachat.
sections.changelog:
1.3.8

  • Conversations tab now shows the customer’s name from the contact form (when provided) instead of the visitor identifier.

1.3.7

  • Added standard plugin metadata, a bundled GPL license, and an English directory readme.
  • Aligned the translation domain with the daniachat package slug.
  • Added an explicit connection/data-sharing confirmation and suggested privacy-policy text.
  • Excluded password-protected and hidden content from knowledge synchronization.
  • Preserved WordPress and other plugins’ dashboard notices.
  • Preserved enqueued widget script attributes and existing installation identifiers.

1.3.6

  • Added product-page context and live product/variation price, stock, and attribute lookup.

1.3.5

  • Added separate desktop and mobile widget position settings.

1.3.4

  • Added initial knowledge synchronization with progress and improved product search.
